content.title: United Airlines Resolves Widespread System Outage
content.caption: United Airlines has resolved a widespread system outage that delayed flight departures.

slides.heading: United Airlines Resolves Widespread System Outage
slides.text: United Airlines has resolved a widespread system outage that delayed flight departures.

slides.heading: What Happened
slides.text: A widespread system outage affected multiple applications used by pilots, including crew communications.
slides.image_search_query: United Airlines pilots' union United States

slides.heading: Why It Matters
slides.text: The outage resolved on Monday, just three days after the Federal Aviation Administration issued a rare nationwide ground stop on all US flights.
